messages:
rachel: deploy-bot reports prod rollout complete for release=v2.15.0 at 2025-09-02T09:20:34Z

deploy-bot: [system] rollout finished: release=v2.15.0 target=prod status=success

tim: starting post-deploy smoke suite. First synth batch shows elevated errors on /api/embeddings: cluster of 503s and a few 504 timeouts. p95 increased from 170ms to ~640ms.

sre-paul: check runtime logs for shard allocation errors, and kvcache warmup stats. Could be a model variant hot path.

nina: gateway traces show upstream 503s with message: "model unavailable - no warm shards" on quantized variant. Also kvcache miss rate spiked x6.

rachel: can we avoid global rollback? Suggest route pin for embed endpoint to last stable version while we investigate.

deploy-bot: run `redwoodctl routes pin --route /api/embeddings --to v2.14.8 --soft --hold 30m`?

rachel: yes please. Soft pin so traffic shifts but fallback still possible.

deploy-bot: executing: `redwoodctl routes pin --route /api/embeddings --to v2.14.8 --soft --hold 30m`

deploy-bot: [success] soft-pin applied. traffic shift complete in ~8s.

tim: after pin, synthetic probes returned 200, p95 back to ~190ms. No new timeouts in the last 3 samples.

sre-paul: capturing runtime snapshots & kernel selection traces, saving to ticket INF-2699. Will check quantization code paths.

qa-bot: checklist reminder: attach failing probe payloads, probe traces, runtime dump, and note soft-pin in release notes.

rachel: decision: apply soft route pin, hold further rollout actions for 30m, open INF-2699 assigned to eng-runtime. No rollback for now.

nina: planning a small 1% nonquant canary after 15m to validate whether quant path caused the regression. Will monitor autoscaling and probes.

rachel: thanks team. keep updates here and escalate if error rate >0.5% or p95 >500ms.
